paths.description: Public landing page and primary app-download discovery journey.
Application listing, representing the primary download-choice flow.
Long-form support/reference template with in-page navigation.
Current news article template with rich images and video.
Data-rich trust/safety page, including charts and background media.
Invalid-route recovery and HTTP status handling.

findings.summary: The site does not follow the system dark-color preference.
findings.evidence: Under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark, the screenshot remained light and the probe reported body background rgb(255,255,255), root color-scheme normal. A manual theme toggle exists, but the initial state is not preference-driven.
findings.suggestedFix: Initialize the theme from prefers-color-scheme, declare color-scheme: light dark, retain the user override, and use dark-mode guidance.

findings.summary: Theme motion still runs when reduced motion is requested.
findings.evidence: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce active, the probe still found the 500 ms t-logo-play animation and 500 ms View Transition rules; the captured theme interaction continued to animate.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential theme and logo animation in no-preference and provide an effectively instant reduced-motion state.

findings.summary: The language menu is an ad-hoc dropdown rather than a semantic disclosure or popover.
findings.evidence: DOM inspection found no popover, dialog, or details elements; the language trigger is an anchor with onclick and href="#", backed by a Bootstrap-style custom menu.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a button plus Popover API or a details disclosure, with declarative light dismiss and explicit expanded state.

findings.summary: Unknown URLs return a soft 404 with no recovery message.
findings.evidence: A request to /this-page-does-not-exist-audit returned HTTP 200 and rendered the homepage without explaining the missing page or offering contextual recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Return HTTP 404 and render a concise not-found state with Home, Apps, FAQ, and search/help recovery actions.

findings.summary: Mobile Largest Contentful Paint misses the good threshold.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP at 3.9 s (performance 0.88), while the raw-CDP trace measured desktop LCP at 895 ms. The mobile result indicates the common constrained condition is not good.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the mobile LCP resource, remove unnecessary early downloads, and verify LCP at or below 2.5 s.

findings.summary: Important images and one linked logo lack accessible alternatives.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt and link-name: two recent-news images have no alt attribute and the logo link has no accessible text. The image primitive independently reported both audited images missing alt.
findings.suggestedFix: Give informative images concise alt text, mark decorative images alt="", and provide the logo link an accessible name.

findings.summary: Primary blue navigation text does not meet minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse contrast checks measured #0088cc on white at 3.89:1 for 15 px navigation links, below WCAG AA 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken the link color or increase size/weight so normal text reaches at least 4.5:1 in every theme.

findings.summary: Document structure lacks landmarks and has skipped or empty headings.
findings.evidence: Across five templates the probe found no main/nav/header/footer landmarks. Homepage starts at h3 and Lighthouse flagged heading order; Safety contains empty h1/h2/h6 elements. The EN trigger also loses its visible outline in the focus probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce semantic landmarks, one meaningful h1 per page, a non-skipping heading hierarchy, remove empty headings, and preserve a strong :focus-visible style.

findings.summary: Images are delivered without responsive sizing, intrinsic dimensions, or below-fold lazy loading.
findings.evidence: The image primitive found 2/2 homepage images missing width/height, srcset, and lazy loading. HAR recorded 665,735 image bytes, led by 323,943 B and 140,534 B below-fold images.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic width and height, provide srcset/sizes, and lazy-load below-fold images while keeping the LCP image eager and prioritized.

findings.summary: Public templates omit standard meta descriptions.
findings.evidence: DOM probes for Home, Apps, FAQ, Safety, and the article all returned no meta[name=description]; Lighthouse SEO failed meta-description despite Open Graph descriptions being present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a unique visible-content-aligned meta description to every public template.

findings.summary: Indexing signals are incomplete and unknown routes are indexable soft 404s.
findings.evidence: robots.txt and sitemap.xml both returned 404; most templates have no canonical link or hreflang, and an invalid URL returns indexable HTTP 200 content.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish robots.txt and sitemap.xml, add self-canonicals and locale hreflang links, and ensure missing URLs return 404.

findings.summary: Several browser-enforced security policies are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. HTTPS, HSTS, and SAMEORIGIN framing protection are present.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a nonce/hash-based CSP in report-only then enforce it; add nosniff, strict-origin-when-cross-origin, and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: Localized pages do not declare their language or direction.
findings.evidence: All five representative DOM probes reported empty html lang and dir despite the site offering many language variants, including Arabic and Persian.
findings.suggestedFix: Set html lang to the selected locale and dir="rtl" for RTL languages; migrate layout rules toward logical properties.

findings.summary: The Safety page autoplays background video.
findings.evidence: The Safety DOM probe found an autoplaying muted video with no controls; autoplay spends media and processing resources before user intent.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a poster by default and start playback after intent or when meaningfully visible; pause it offscreen and under reduced motion.

findings.summary: A mostly unused global stylesheet is render-blocking.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 26 KiB unused CSS (84.7% of telegram.css), and HAR confirms three parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets before content.
findings.suggestedFix: Split template CSS, remove dead selectors, and inline only the genuinely critical rules.

findings.summary: Article and support media lack complete text alternatives and playback controls.
findings.evidence: Article probes found multiple images with no alt and three videos without controls or tracks; FAQ also contains unlabeled images and videos without controls/tracks.
findings.suggestedFix: Add meaningful alt text or empty alt for decoration, expose controls, and provide captions/transcripts where video conveys information.

taskList.title: Restore semantic, named, structured and contrast-compliant content
Add CSP and the missing defensive response policies
Fix soft 404s and publish complete indexing metadata
Optimize and correctly size responsive images to improve mobile LCP
Honor system theme and reduced-motion preferences
Replace the custom language dropdown with a semantic disclosure
